propositions: Documentation-only patchsets currently consume the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs instead of a reduced docs-only lane with retained documentation gates.

A trusted classifier job executing from origin/main must safely route patchsets to docs-only or full Verify based on allowlisted path categories without executing untrusted patchset-controlled classifier logic or configuration.

Documentation-related gates (ADR number/index/cross-reference validation, docs-index/README quickstart validation, CLI/MCP/env-registry drift validation) must be extracted into a single shared composite action invoked by both docs-only and full routes without duplicating commands or adding runner jobs.

Classifier failure, empty/malformed diffs, non-allowlisted paths (Python, shell, workflows, dependencies, tests, configuration, unknown), or parent-resolution failure must select the full route and block Verified until successfully classified.

All workflow structure consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, and seven others) must migrate to follow extracted documentation gates without weakening assertions.

Production proof must demonstrate genuine docs-only changes consume 82%+ less wall clock and runner-minutes than baseline while retaining all documentation validation gates, and genuine non-doc changes complete the full test suite without executing the docs-only route.
